compositionRequirements: Combine mandatory common tools with role requirements, actual work and explicit service requirements.
An agent explains each inclusion, omission, allocation and missing input; it does not invent prices or allocation percentages.
All contributing people require the common base; this does not imply a new full provider subscription per quote, person or service.
Deduplicate costs by subscription, period and assignment identity, not by provider name; distinct named users may require separate seats.
Paid subscriptions already held remain costs to attribute; new cash requirements are separate.
Shared seats, client supply, FTE discounts and portfolio allocation require explicit coverage and policy.
AI resources are selected for work that needs them; no universal AI seat or simultaneous ChatGPT plus Claude requirement was specified.
Services include selected internal resource costs while retaining their agreed commercial unit and scope.
